title: Most Frequent Character
statement:
Given a string S of lowercase English letters, find the character that appears most frequently.

If there is a tie (multiple characters have the same maximum frequency), print the one that comes first in alphabetical order.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 10^5
S contains only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: A single character: the most frequent character (alphabetically first in case of tie).

examples.explanation: a appears 2 times, b appears 3 times, c appears 1 time. 'b' is the most frequent.
Both 'a' and 'b' appear 2 times. 'a' comes first alphabetically.
